quiz.intro.title: What matters when choosing hair care
quiz.intro.oil.title: Scalp oil
quiz.intro.oil.body: Fast-oiling scalps need enough cleansing power; slower or drier scalps do better with gentle surfactants.
quiz.intro.dandruff.title: Flakes and itch
quiz.intro.dandruff.body: Dandruff responds to proven actives such as piroctone olamine or zinc pyrithione; fragrance and essential oils can make a sensitive scalp itchier.
quiz.intro.hair.title: Hair condition
quiz.intro.hair.body: Damage, color, perms, fine or fragile hair decide how much repair and conditioning you need.
quiz.intro.env.title: Environment
quiz.intro.env.body: Hard water means less lather and more residue, so chelating agents help; humidity and season change how oily or dry your scalp gets.
quiz.intro.privacy: About 2 minutes. Everything but the last question is optional, and answers stay in your browser.

about.title: Disclaimer and privacy
about.d.notMedical: Recommendations here come from fixed rules applied to public information. They are for reference only, are not medical advice, and do not replace a doctor's diagnosis or treatment. No AI is used to generate recommendations.
about.d.doctor: The "health notes" on the results page are prompts, not diagnoses. If your scalp stays red, hurts, oozes, you lose noticeably more hair, or things get worse, consider seeing a dermatologist.
about.d.rules: Scoring rules and weights are initial settings and will be adjusted based on feedback. A score shows how well a product fits what you told us, not how good the product is.
about.d.claims: "Brand claims" come from brand product pages and "data classification" is how we categorized a product; neither is an independently verified effect.
about.d.fragrance: "Fragrance-free" and "no fragrance ingredient found" are based on ingredient lists and do not guarantee the absence of allergens. If you are prone to allergies, patch test first.
about.d.productInfo: Ingredient lists, prices and sizes come from public brand and retailer pages and may have changed; formulas can also differ by region and batch. Check the packaging and the seller's page before buying.
about.d.links: We do not sell products, show ads or take affiliate commissions. Purchase links go to third-party retailers, who are responsible for prices, stock and after-sales service.
about.d.testMode: This is a development test build: some ingredient data that has not been reviewed yet is used in scoring, and affected products are marked "Test data, not yet verified".
about.p.local: Your answers and profiles are stored only in the browser you are using (local storage), and recommendations are calculated in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to our servers. Your language setting is also stored locally.
about.p.noAccount: No account is needed, and we do not collect names, email addresses or phone numbers. Profile names (like "Me" or "Mom") stay on your device.
about.p.noTracking: The site's code contains no analytics, advertising or tracking scripts, and uses no cookies to record your activity.
about.p.hosting: The site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Like any website, the hosting provider may keep standard access logs (such as IP address, browser type and time of visit); these logs do not include your answers.
about.p.external: Purchase links and source links take you to other websites, whose privacy policies apply.
about.p.delete: To clear your data, delete profiles on the Profile page or clear this site's data in your browser settings. Profiles do not sync across browsers or devices.
about.s.cosing: Ingredient basics: the European Commission's CosIng database (retrieved {d}); fragrance allergens: Annex III of the EU Cosmetics Regulation.
about.s.products: Products: public brand and retailer pages; each product's details list its sources and review date.
about.s.water: Water hardness: public water quality reports from local utilities, valid only for the system or sampling point they describe.
about.s.open: This project is open source; the scoring rules and all data can be viewed in the code repository.

data.title: How recommendations work
data.intro: Product cards show only the conclusions you need. This page explains the rules and data behind them. Everything uses fixed rules; no AI is involved.
data.fit.title: Fit level and score
data.fit.1: The fit level comes from the fit score: great fit (70+), good fit (40–69), fair fit (below 40). The score is under Details → Score breakdown.
data.fit.2: The fit score combines need match (50%), irritation risk (25%), evidence (15%) and environment, meaning water hardness (10%). Parts that do not apply to you or have no data are left out and the rest is reweighted; the breakdown lists only the parts that were scored.
data.fit.3: If a need is supported only by a brand claim or data classification, with no ingredient or test evidence, the total is capped at what weak evidence would give.
data.fit.4: If you choose no specific needs, there is no fit level; products are sorted by gentleness and price, and cards show gentleness.
data.basis.title: Labels after each reason
data.basis.tested: Product test: supported by a reliable test of the finished product, the strongest basis. None in the data yet.
data.basis.ingredients: Ingredients: based on active or irritating ingredients in the list. Ingredient function is only a supporting match and does not tell how smooth hair will be or how long a scent lasts.
data.basis.brand_claim: Brand claim: from the brand's product page; not an independently verified effect.
data.basis.classification: Classification: how we categorized the product when compiling data; not the brand's wording.
data.basis.award: Award: media awards or retailer best-seller lists, with source and year.
data.ingredients.title: Ingredients
data.ingredients.1: Key ingredients list only actives and ingredients to watch (up to 5). The full list and the original label text are under "See all ingredients".
data.ingredients.2: Tap an ingredient for a plain-language explanation and its EU CosIng functions. Functions describe the role in a formula, not a proven effect; some explanations are drafts and are marked as not yet reviewed.
data.ingredients.3: Most ingredient data is still being reviewed.
data.fragrance.title: Fragrance-free
data.fragrance.1: "Fragrance-free" covers two cases: the label says fragrance-free, or no fragrance ingredient appears in the list. Card details say which.
data.fragrance.2: Fragrance ingredients include fragrance/parfum, EU-labelled fragrance allergens, ingredients on our fragrance list, and essential oils.
data.fragrance.3: This is based on the ingredient list and does not guarantee the absence of allergens. If you are prone to allergies, patch test first.
data.gentle.title: Gentleness
data.gentle.1: Gentleness looks for common irritants in the ingredient list: fragrance, essential oils, alcohol, strong acids and sensitizers, plus strong cleansers if you wash daily.
data.gentle.2: Rinse-off products stay on the scalp briefly, so their effect counts half; it counts double for a sensitive scalp.
data.ratings.title: Retailer ratings
data.ratings.1: Ratings come from product pages at retailers such as Ulta, Sephora, Target and Amazon. They are for reference only and do not affect the fit.
data.ratings.2: Platforms with fewer than {n} reviews are not shown; cards show only the platform with the most reviews, with no cross-platform average.
data.ratings.3: Some reviews may come from free product samples; sizes or scents may be counted together; platforms count reviews differently (Amazon includes star-only ratings).
data.ratings.4: Ratings and purchase links carry a check date and may change.
data.products.title: Product information
data.products.1: Ingredient lists, prices and sizes come from public brand and retailer pages and may have changed; formulas can differ by region and batch.
data.products.2: Product photos come only from openly licensed sources such as Open Beauty Facts; credit and license are at the bottom of card details. Products without a photo use a placeholder.
data.products.3: Water hardness comes from local utilities' public reports and applies only to the system or sampling point they describe.
